title: TNew zombies
description:
this mod add new zombies
new rule for survive
body:
Have you ever experienced standard zombies becoming too easy? They're no longer terrifying? Then I have an original solution. TNew. This mod adds 4 new types of zombies. 1. D zombies will have slightly more HP. 2. Y zombies, which already have a lot of HP. 3. R zombies, which don't have high health but deal massive damage. 4. S zombies, which are fast but deal low health. This mod is perfect for Minecraft-style zombie apocalypse builds, or you can install it in your own world to make it a little more fun.

**The mod has been tested on version 1.21.1 neoforge-21.1.176.**

**The mod is in alpha.**

This mod will add about 18 zombies, 4 main types, the rest are types of clothing on zombies.
